prompt: Same goal, if/put/get variant: if `m` lacks cl[i], put a new ArrayDeque for it; then `Deque<Integer> q = m.get(cl[i]);`.
answer:
if (!m.containsKey(cl[i])) m.put(cl[i], new ArrayDeque<>());
Deque<Integer> q = m.get(cl[i]);
why: The if/put/get form does the same in two steps; use containsKey then put then get.
